decision_test: AM I DOING WHAT I SHOULD BE DOING?
purpose: Carry one work identity recursively through authoritative sector boundaries without copying sector implementations or losing legal identity, state, lineage, evidence, failure state or continuation.
invariants: one work_id survives the whole chain
canonical repo identity is preserved even while implementation is transitionally located elsewhere
target execution must return a receipt/readback before the next externally consequential mutation is promoted
failures become state and evidence; they are never rewritten as success
descendant work inherits lineage by reference rather than copying parent systems
primitive: ADDRESS -> RESOLVE -> AUTHORIZE -> APPLY -> RECEIPT -> OBSERVE -> REWRITE
recursive_cycle: locate existing implementation or declared transitional implementation
handoff only the required state/reference set
resolve next sector from actual result
anti_patterns: copy the entire source sector into the target repo
create a new registry when a canonical identity already exists
promote a handoff manifest to proof of target execution
treat a missing named repo as a missing runtime when a declared transitional implementation exists
let BRAINK silently become owner of a downstream sector mutation
let a downstream sector rewrite the legal/business identity relationship
